mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower or tub upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard shower or tub upgrade project typically takes between one to three weeks from demolition to completion, assuming no major structural or plumbing issues are uncovered. The timeline can be extended if custom materials are ordered, significant layout changes are made, or if unexpected repairs are needed. We provide a projected timeline during the planning phase, and regular communication keeps you informed of progress.
